research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Rapt Therapeutics is researching compounds and methods for modulating chemokine receptor activity, as described in Chemokine receptor modulators and uses thereof, and developing crystalline forms of C-C chemokine receptor type 4 antagonists for oral administration, as detailed in Crystalline forms of c-c chemokine receptor type 4 antagonist and uses thereof. They are also working on pyrazole pyrimidine compounds to modulate or inhibit hematopoietic progenitor kinase 1. These efforts focus on small-molecule immune system activation.

identifier.value: RPT904 is similar to SEP-631 (MRGPRX2) Negative Allosteric Modulator

overview_description.description: RAPT Therapeutics is a clinical stage immunology-based biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing and commercializing oral small molecule therapies for patients with significant unmet needs in oncology and inflammatory diseases. Utilizing its proprietary discovery and development engine, the company is developing highly selective small molecules designed to modulate the critical immune responses underlying these diseases. In its first four years since inception, RAPT has discovered and advanced two unique drug candidates, each targeting C-C motif chemokine receptor 4. The company’s lead oncology drug candidate, FLX475, reached the clinic in just two and a half years with its lead inflammation drug candidate, RPT193, also in the clinic. The company is also pursuing a range of targets, including general control nonderepressible 2 and hematopoietic progenitor kinase 1, that are in the discovery stage of development.
